Definition: to tumble, i.e. be violently agitated; specifically, to crash (of thunder); figuratively, to irritate (with anger)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to thunder; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to make the sound of thunder, thunder; 1a2) to rage; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to thunder, cause thunder; 1b2) to tremble, cause to tremble (by extension)
